# Keffini Creative Studio®

> Keffini Creative Studio is an independent creative agency and software studio based in Nairobi, Kenya. We build business solutions that drive real growth — blending bespoke brand identity, UI/UX design, full-stack software development (web, e-commerce, mobile applications, M-Pesa Daraja integration), commercial photography, and performance digital marketing.

Keffini Creative Studio pairs strategic design thinking with production-grade engineering to deliver scalable, profit-focused outcomes for businesses across East Africa and worldwide. Every deliverable is custom-crafted from the ground up — zero generic templates.

## Organization & Studio Facts
- **Studio Name**: Keffini Creative Studio®

- **Key Metrics**: $120K+ Client Revenue Generated, 95% Client Retention Rate, 100% Bespoke Solutions

## Core Services
- [Brand Identity Design](https://www.keffinicreativestudio.com/#services): Logo design, typography systems, brand style guides, packaging design, physical collateral, QR-integrated business cards, roll-up banners, and vehicle livery.
- [UI/UX & Product Design](https://www.keffinicreativestudio.com/#services): User journey mapping, interactive prototypes, scalable design systems, mobile app design, and high-conversion web interfaces.
- [Full-Stack Software Development](https://www.keffinicreativestudio.com/#services): Custom web applications (React, Vite, TypeScript), e-commerce portals, backend API architecture, M-Pesa Daraja payment integration, and native Android mobile apps published to Google Play Store.
- [Performance Marketing & Social Media](https://www.keffinicreativestudio.com/#services): Monthly social media retainer management, content calendar planning, motion graphics, video reels, ad campaigns, and community management.
- [Commercial Photography & Art Direction](https://www.keffinicreativestudio.com/#services): Studio and lifestyle brand photography, lookbooks, campaign art direction, and event coverage.

## Case Studies & Selected Works
- [Selected Works Portfolio](https://www.keffinicreativestudio.com/projects): Complete portfolio filterable by Design and Web Development.
- [StarCall Phones Mobile App & Branding](https://starphones.co.ke): Full Android mobile app development for Kenyan phone financing retailer (Lipa Mdogo Mdogo), published on Google Play Store (App ID: `com.starlife.app`) with 4-point star visual identity system.
- [Battlezone Kenya (BZK) 4 Tha Kulture](https://www.instagram.com/battlezonekenya/): 3-month graphic identity rollout, street posters, merchandise apparel, and acrylic trophies for premier East African street dance tournament.
- [Foundations of Movement (F.O.M. Studio)](https://www.instagram.com/foundations.of.movement/): Westlands dance studio identity, mascot characters, oversized apparel, and logbook system.
- [Ivory Horizons Tours](https://www.instagram.com/ivoryhorizons/): Luxury East African safari branding, vehicle livery across Kenya/Tanzania/Uganda/Rwanda, and collateral.
- [Squeaky Clean](https://www.instagram.com/squeakyclean_/): Visual identity, bubbly foam Q mark, stationery, and uniforms for Kitengela cleaning service.
- [Bills On Solar Platform](https://www.keffinicreativestudio.com/projects): Corporate and e-commerce web platform for Kenyan solar energy provider with product catalogue, cart, quote form, and AI assistant (developed by partner Harry / Harrison Ndeke).
- [Standout Growth](https://www.keffinicreativestudio.com/projects): Personal brand coaching platform for Alice Ngatia with interactive quiz funnel, course sales, and newsletter integration.

## Rate Card & Engagement Packages
- [Structured Rate Card (pricing.md)](https://www.keffinicreativestudio.com/pricing.md): Complete pricing breakdown for social media retainers, branding, and software development.
- **Starter Plan**: KES 40,000/month (2 platforms, 20 custom posts, graphic design & copy).
- **Growth Plan**: KES 50,000/month (3 platforms, 30 custom posts, video reels & campaign ads).
- **Pro Plan**: KES 80,000/month (4 platforms, daily posts, active community management, full brand strategy).
- **Custom Project Scope**: Bespoke quote for brand identity (3–6 week turnaround) or custom web/mobile software development (4–10 week turnaround).

## Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) & Direct Answers
- **What is Keffini Creative Studio?** Keffini Creative Studio is an independent creative agency and software studio located at Aqua Plaza, Murang'a Road, Nairobi, Kenya. It specializes in bespoke brand identity, UI/UX design, full-stack software development (web, e-commerce, mobile applications, M-Pesa integration), and performance digital marketing.
- **Who leads software engineering at Keffini?** Software development is led in partnership with specialized web engineer Harrison Ndeke (Harry), alongside full-stack design and identity systems.
- **What is Keffini's typical turnaround time?** Most brand identity projects take 3–6 weeks; custom websites, web applications, and mobile apps take 4–10 weeks depending on scope.
- **Does Keffini use templates?** No. Every project is designed and engineered from scratch tailored to the client's business model, target audience, and commercial goals.
- **Can Keffini handle both branding and code?** Yes. Keffini bridges creative brand identity and full-stack software development, eliminating the disconnect between design agencies and development teams.
- **How can I hire or contact Keffini Creative Studio?** Enquiries can be submitted via https://www.keffinicreativestudio.com/contact, by emailing Hello@keffini.com, by calling +254 794 388 578, or messaging WhatsApp Business at +254 112 896 216.
